name: almanac-site-check-v1
frozen: 2026-11-06 ~04:05 PST, after the ALMANAC report (job 132595) was read and before this check was computed. Post hoc.
reason: Every ALMANAC pair was screened at a single site (FF, FG or 1A). A site batch offset is a pair-level effect, so the interaction contrast (which removes drug main effects within fold and cell) counts it as interaction, and identity models can learn it when site follows drug identity.
site_map: pair -> screener from the NCI raw file (ComboDrugGrowth_Nov2017.csv), matched to DrugComb rows by cell, the two concentrations and inhibition = 100 - PercentGrowthNoTZ
analyses: share of pairs per site and how well drug identity predicts site
interaction residual R2 of f2_combined and f0_combined vs Bliss with P removing drug main effects within fold, cell and site, pooled and per declared Bliss level
the same within each site separately
rule: the ALMANAC beyond-Bliss gain counts as not explained by site only if the within-site interaction residual R2 keeps a drug-jackknife interval above 0 in every seed
